text:
nina: Hey all — thinking of a sunset mini-putt + picnic on the plaza next Friday at 6:30pm. Low-key, bring a small snack to share. Thoughts? :golf:

owen: Love it. I can bring a portable blanket and a little speaker.

claire: In! I'll make a big Greek salad (no nuts). Anyone allergic?

tom: Im down. Can volunteers bring a few folding chairs?

sophia: I have 2 chairs and a battery lantern. Also can we do a quick poll on picnic vibe: A) casual picnic B) picnic + mini-putt tournament C) just drinks/snacks and hang

kyle: B for tournament (prize = bragging rights + sticker?).

nina: Sticker crown for winners sounds perfect. :crown:

owen: Quick logistics Q : does facilities allow mini sports on the plaza?

eventbot: Facilities notified. No amplified music after 9pm; small activities ok under public use policy.

claire: Allergies: none here. I'll label salad with dairy note.

tom: I'll borrow 3 folding chairs from training room.

sophia: RSVP so far: nina, owen, claire, tom, sophia, kyle. If youre in drop a Y.

owen: Y

kyle: Y (bringing mini putter set)

nina: I'll print simple scorecards and bring utensils/napkins. See you Friday!
